note: Every shipped asset under apps/client/public/assets must match an entry (glob patterns allowed). CI fails otherwise. The credits screen is generated from this file. "bundled" lists third-party assets shipped from npm packages (fonts).

entries.title: Map props (rocks, trees, bushes, junk, street furniture, city buildings, Echo crystals)
